description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy class, verifying its behavior with placeholder substitution in ACL entries within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy behavior, particularly with placeholder substitution in ACL entries.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that the apply method returns the original command when no placeholders are present.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that the apply method correctly replaces placeholders in ACL entries when present.
